Subject: Re: m b beta from CPAN - More patches for VMS

Ken Williams wrote:
> On 11/6/07, Craig A. Berry  wrote:
>> I think you and I agreed that the is_vmsish property should remain an
>> indication of what OS we are on and not get tangled up with what make
>> utility is in use (though a separate property might well track that).
> 
> Yes, although I bet John's right that it would Huffman-code better to
> put the make-related stuff right in is_vmsish(), I think it turns
> is_vmsish() into a misleadingly-named method.  So I think we should
> have a separate method like using_vms_make() or something.

I would vote for is_vms_mms as MMS is the program initials, and it is a 
test, not a statement.  MMS stands for Module Management System.  MMK is 
an open source program that uses mostly the same syntax as MMS.  MMK 
stands for Madgoat MaKe.

-John
